ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Used to create #anchor-links on the page. Use only letters, numbers, and hyphens.

Heading.helper: Optional. Main heading for this button section. Formatted text and links are allowed and will render in the view.

Lead.helper: Optional. Supporting text under the heading. Formatted text and links are allowed and will render in the view.
Lead.placeholder: Tell visitors why they should take the next step here.

CTA1Text.helper: Required. Text for the main button button. Formatted text and links are allowed and will render in the view.

CTA1Icon.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

CTA1Link.helper: Required. Select or enter the web addresses for the main button button.

CTA2Text.helper: Optional. Text for the secondary button button. Formatted text and links are allowed and will render in the view.

CTA2Icon.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

CTA2Link.helper: Optional. Select or enter the web addresses for the secondary button button.
